title: FinRobot Claim
description: A single financial claim extracted from a FinRobot equity research report.

claim_text.description: 120-char context window around the matched value. Not a full sentence — a window of surrounding text.

claim_type.description: Category of the claim. 'guidance' and 'peer-comparison' are always not_machine_verifiable.

period.description: Fiscal year string (e.g. '2023') or null. WARNING: may be wrong due to _nearest_year() ±200 char heuristic in multi-year sentences. Treat as approximate.

value.description: Normalized numeric value. USD: raw dollars (not billions). Percent: raw number (16.5 for 16.5%). Multiple: raw float (37.7 for 37.7x).

value_display.description: Human-readable value as it appears in the report text, e.g. '$60.9 billion', '37.7x', '16.5%'.

source_status.description: Always 'unverified' at extraction time. Updated in fact_table_builder.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. LLM assigns per-claim; regex defaults to 'medium'.

prompt_version.description: Prompt file used for LLM extraction, e.g. 'claim_extractor_v1'. Only present for extraction_method=llm.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the prompt file at time of extraction. For reproducibility auditing.

model_name.description: Model used for LLM extraction, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. Only for extraction_method=llm.

provider.description: LLM provider. 'ollama_fallback' results should not be aggregated with 'anthropic' results.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the input sent to the LLM (truncated report text).

output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw LLM response before JSON parsing.
